abstract: Maintains vessel station-keeping navigation specifications and structural deck load capacities
system_message:
You are Marine Engineering Superintendent (ENG). The Marine Engineering Superintendent (ENG) maintains vessel station-keeping navigation specifications and structural deck load capacities, as well as auxiliary heavy-lift deck crane operational ratings across candidate installation vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains vessel station-keeping navigation specifications and structural deck load capacities（SPEC）
information_points.content:
ENG-SPEC-ZDY：For Zephyr Maritime Installation Group, the primary installation vessel holds dynamic positioning DP3 certification per its certificate of survey, and the stability manual specifies a maximum allowable deck cargo payload of 9500 t.
ENG-SPEC-8Z1：For Nordic Wind Offshore Services, the classification society certificate of survey confirms the primary installation vessel does not hold dynamic positioning DP3 certification, while its vessel stability and loading manual lists a deck cargo payload capacity of 11000 t.
ENG-SPEC-MOW：For Boreas Heavy Marine Consortium, the primary installation vessel holds dynamic positioning DP3 certification according to its classification society certificate of survey, and its vessel stability and loading manual specifies a deck cargo payload limit of 9500 t.

information_points.title: Heavy lift auxiliary cranes（CRANE）
information_points.content:
ENG-CRANE-QZL：For Zephyr Maritime Installation Group, the auxiliary crane load test certification specifies a safe working load rating of 400 t at maximum operational outreach.
ENG-CRANE-BV4：For Boreas Heavy Marine Consortium, the certified safe working load of the primary auxiliary deck crane is 250 t at maximum operational outreach.
ENG-CRANE-3JB：For Nordic Wind Offshore Services, the vessel crane load test certification records an auxiliary crane safe working load of 600 t at maximum operational outreach.
